notes: The Hebrew writes הֲ and לֹא once, at the head of the first clause, and the ASV rewrites both over the coordinated clause; every occurrence belongs to the one morpheme's discontinuous unit (rule 25). Marking the second *Did not* `added` was the competing reading.
עֹשֵׂנִי is anarthrous, so the supplied *he that* joins the participle's own unit and the head stays on *made* (rule 46).
